def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # infer the repeating directional pattern: colored symbols in top/bottom quadrants encode objects,
    # mirror/reflect patterns into matching adjacent cell regions.
    # For demo: region row-block below: two symbols in cols 10 and 5; reflect first shape across vertical axis.
    # Overall puzzle likely each shape is copied by reflection in its panel.
    # Identify separator rows/cols, then symmetry-complete colored nonseparator cells within each compartment.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]);
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==g[i][0] for v in row) and g[i][0]!=0]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(h)) and g[0][j]!=0]
    # colored object panels and arrange based on corresponding shape panels: copy/mirror objects in each row band
    # For each band, shapes in a panel define reflection into other panel(s) based on available objects.
    # Complete horizontal mirror for colored objects in panel pairs, as demonstrated: panel with 4 at col8 mirrored into col11.
    bounds=[-1]+rs+[h]
    cbounds=[-1]+cs+[w]
    for bi in range(len(bounds)-1):
      top,bot=bounds[bi]+1,bounds[bi+1]
      for bj in range(len(cbounds)-1):
       left,right=cbounds[bj]+1,cbounds[bj+1]
       cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(top,bot) for c in range(left,right) if g[r][c] not in (0, g[0][0])]
       # Reflection rule to complete shape around vertical/horizontal panel axes, use symmetry across panel centers.
       for r,c,v in cells:
        cc=left+right-1-c
        if left<=cc<right and g[r][cc]==0: g[r][cc]=v
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find full-color separator lines
    rs=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    # In each horizontal band, replicate any single nonempty pattern into adjacent empty panels,
    # reflecting horizontally; use repeated panels as pattern exemplars.
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
      y0,y1=a+1,b
      panels=[]
      for xleft,xright in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
        x0,x1=xleft+1,xright
        pat={(r-y0,c-x0):g[r][c] for r in range(y0,y1) for c in range(x0,x1) if g[r][c] not in (0,)}
        panels.append((x0,x1,pat))
      for i,(x0,x1,p) in enumerate(panels):
        if not p: continue
        # matching mirrored copy is placed in neighboring empty panel
        for j in (i-1,i+1):
          if 0<=j<len(panels) and not panels[j][2]:
            xx0,xx1,_=panels[j]
            # reflected coordinates, preserving width
            for (dy,dx),v in p.items():
              tx=xx0+(x1-x0-1-dx)
              if y0+dy<y1 and xx0<=tx<xx1 and g[y0+dy][tx]==0: g[y0+dy][tx]=v
    return g
PY
